    Financial Control Centre

    Revenue, costs, expenses, staff, purchases and settlements in one place. Reads from your Tracker, Expenses, Staff Payment and Purchase Records tabs.

    Business Expenses

    Add every business expense yourself and map it to a category and a platform (or General). Saved on this device and included in Backup.

    Return Tracking

    Every Return and RTO from Meesho, Flipkart, Myntra and Amazon, taken live from the Tracker sheets. Each box starts as NO (red) and turns YES (green) once the parcel is back with you. Click the box to switch.

    Purchase Records

    A plain record of what we bought: item, amount and date of purchase. This is for our records only. Nothing here is deducted from, or added to, any other tab.

    Invoice

    Fill in the buyer and items. The tax invoice below updates as you type. Use Download PDF to save it as a PDF file, or Print to print it. GST is split into CGST + SGST when the place of supply is the same state as your GST number (Delhi), and IGST for other states.

    Items

    Type or pick a product SKU (your own SKU or any marketplace SKU from the Products tab) and the name, HSN, rate and GST fill in automatically.

    Payments receivedAdd every payment against this invoice. Received, balance due and the status are worked out for you.
    Payment QR code (Scan & pay) Upload the QR image customers should scan. It is printed on the invoice.

    Payment reminders

    Saved invoices (0)

    Invoices are saved automatically when you download or print them. Saving again with the same invoice number updates that invoice.

    Credit notes / cancellations (0)

    Issued invoices are never deleted. Press Cancel on a saved invoice to cancel it with a reason. A credit note is created and linked to the original invoice.

    Available Ready Stock

    Track how many pieces of each product you have, and get a warning when stock runs low.

    Type how many pieces you have. “New sales” counts orders dated after the day you set the number; tap Apply to subtract them. Saved automatically.

    Top 10 Sold Products

    Last year and this year side by side. Only real sales are counted: cancelled, Return and RTO orders are left out. Use the filters to look at a whole year or a single month.

    State-wise Sales

    Which state generates the most orders, and from which platform. Built live from the Tracker sheets (Flipkart and Website/Offline take the state from the matching Sale entry address).
